name: @digitaltwin/design-system-monorepo
description: DigitalTwin Design System — React/Next UI kit + design tokens

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run build -w @digitaltwin/testing -w @digitaltwin/types -w @digitaltwin/constants -w @digitaltwin/config -w @digitaltwin/utils -w @digitaltwin/i18n -w @digitaltwin/auth -w @digitaltwin/api && npm run build -w @digitaltwin/design-system
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:manifest && npm run build && npm run dev -w @digitaltwin/design-system-docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:manifest && npm run build && npm run build -w @digitaltwin/design-system-docs
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only && npm run format
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:graph && npm run build:tokens && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
